messages:
maya (Docs): Hey all — quick sync: we got feedback from a customer that our Private deployment docs use inconsistent voice and some non-inclusive terms. Can we converge on phrasing and a short SDK snippet that shows accessibility-friendly output formatting?
kevin (Eng): Yup saw that. I can help with example that returns both plain text and structured output for screen readers.
asha (Product): Thanks — also want to ensure we use 'Redwood' vs 'we' consistently in public docs. Product prefers 'Redwood' for feature descriptions, but 'we' is OK in guides.
jonathan (DevEx): Quick proposal: docs should use 'Redwood' when describing product capabilities; use first-person plural in step-by-step guides. Short, consistent rule.
luis (Legal): One ask from compliance: avoid absolute claims like "zero risk" or "guaranteed private". Use qualifiers. Also watch accessibility-related regulatory phrasing.
maya (Docs): Cool. Action items: (1) update style guide snippet, (2) add SDK example showing accessible formatted responses, (3) run quick glossary pass for "private/dedicated/hosted" terms. Can volunteers take these?
kevin (Eng): I can draft the SDK snippet. Here's a minimal example I tested:
```js
// Accessible response example
const resp = await redwood.generate({
  model: 'rw-1-large',
  input: 'Summarize for screen readers:\n- short bullets\n',
  format: 'json'
});
// Provide plain_text for TTS/screen readers plus structured bullets for navigation
console.log(resp.plain_text);
console.log(resp.structured.bullets);
```
jonathan (DevEx): Nice. Can you make the snippet language-agnostic? We need the same pattern in Python and Go snippets in the SDK docs.
kevin (Eng): Yep — will add python example and a note about using `plain_text` + `structured` fields.
maya (Docs): I'll update the style guide doc under docs/style/voice.md with the rule and Quick Examples section. Linking PR soon.
sha (docs-bot): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 (maya)
asha (Product): Also suggest adding a glossary entry for "Private deployment" that clarifies "private control plane" vs "customer-managed network" — small wording difference that confuses customers.
luis (Legal): I can review glossary language for regulatory-safe terms.
jonathan (DevEx): For migration guide callouts: add a short "what changed" snippet for customers moving from Hosted -> Private, incl. voice change examples (e.g., "we" vs "Redwood").
maya (Docs): Great. Timeline: PRs by EOD Friday. kevin: SDK snippets?
kevin (Eng): I'll have initial snippets by Thu noon.
maya (Docs): Perfect. I'll open the style guide PR and a follow-up glossary PR. If anyone wants to join review ping me. :thumbsup:
kevin (Eng): Pinged the docs PR with a small test harness in the branch.
jonathan (DevEx): I'll add a sample CI lint rule to flag inconsistent uses of "we" vs "Redwood" in docs .md files — low effort.
maya (Docs): Thanks — closing the loop here. If anything blocks review, drop a note in this thread.
